speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden onset abdominal pain; can you describe exactly where the pain is located and if it has moved to any other area?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia.

Based on your history of a recent heart attack and current symptoms of abdominal pain starting around the navel with bloody stools, this is highly suggestive of blocked blood flow to your intestines. I need to confirm if you have any history of atrial fibrillation or if you are currently on any blood thinners. REQUEST TEST: CT Angiography of the Abdomen and Pelvis.
